answer: The kernel counter is kept in knoll and echo shows each reset. An attacker hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 32 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 32 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1773 identities would post 3734 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
